title: last night was a movie
overview: Allan E. Smith is an aspiring filmmaker who admires influencers and content creators. As such, his inspirations grow increasingly stark when he decides to make a short film utilizing the vertical format.

title: Signals
overview: Plot TBA. Described by Dupieux as “an experiment, an artistic happening” about the medium of television.

title: Descendants of the Sun
overview: An official Indonesian remake of South Korea's drama series with the same title.

title: Oki & Nirmala
overview: Set in a magical fairytale land, this story follows the adventures of Oki—a cheerful yet clumsy ten-year-old green dwarf—and Nirmala, a graceful and kind-hearted forest fairy whose magic wand is always ready to help.

title: Two Seasons, Two Strangers
overview: In summer, Nagisa and Natsuo meet by the sea. Their vacant gazes reflect each other as they exchange awkward words and wade into the rain-drenched ocean. In winter, Li, a screenwriter, travels to a snow-covered village. There, she finds a guesthouse run by Benzo.

title: The Wild Between Us
overview: Liam and Ava live far from civilization with their young son, Aru. When Liam returns from a hunting trip to discover signs of a bear, and the lifeless body of his wife, he is left alone with his child. Convinced that the wild is no place for a boy, Liam embarks on a perilous horseback journey to find someone he can trust with Aru’s future. As father and son venture deeper into the wilderness, their journey becomes a meditation on grief, survival and the meaning of paternal instinct.

title: Gatto
overview: After years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, a scrappy black cat named Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, a ruthless local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose—unless Venice gets the better of him first.

title: More Than Gold
overview: When three working-class friends find hidden gold on a renovation job, their dream of a better life puts their morals and friendship to the test.

title: Badinter
overview: Biopic about the famous French lawyer and politician, Robert Badinter.

title: Fish in a Barrel
overview: A group of friends devise a plan to avoid the workforce after graduating college. This plan however, could be detrimental to their lives.

title: Kaamelott: The Second Chapter (Part II)
overview: Third and final film in the Kaamelott franchise.

title: Winter of the Crow
overview: Warsaw, 1981. Martial law shuts down the country, turning it into a prison overnight. Taxis are replaced by tanks, citizens are treated like criminals, and visiting British Professor Joan Andrews finds herself trapped. After witnessing the murder of a young student by the secret police, Joan herself becomes the target.

title: The Exorcist: Martyrs
overview: Thirteen years ago, New York City detective Julie Miller ended the terror reign of satanic serial killer Father Sunday. The case made her a hero, and she has thrown herself into her work ever since. Now a new killer scrawls her name in an altar boy's blood on the walls of a church crypt, dragging her back into the darkness she believed she had buried with him.

title: Blue Hour
overview: This morning, Aimée turns 21, it's her birthday, and she's giving herself 24 hours before her life comes to an end.

title: Bristol
overview: Simona, in her forties, has been a teacher in Annecy for several years, where she lives with her husband and daughter. As the summer holidays approach, she receives an unexpected message. A past she thought she'd erased resurfaces, questioning and jeopardising the balance of her new life.

title: Elsinore
overview: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

title: Ashes
overview: Lucila leaves Mexico with her younger brother to reunite with their mother in Madrid, who had left a few years earlier to chase a better future. When they finally arrive, the bitter, suffocating reality that awaits them proves far harsher than Lucila had imagined. Still, she is determined to make the most of this fragile new life.

title: Justice Hearts
overview: The solo origin story of the American-Korean actor Lewis Cosgrove. But Lewis Cosgrove is an American born raised western boy who has Korean heritage, but does not have Korean blood, his DNA comes from his American blood. The story will begin with the 13 year old Lewis Cosgrove in 2016.

title: Threnodia
overview: A runaway couple takes on a journey of love, subconsciousness, and remorse; while believing that a homeless gay man is God.

title: The Nightingale
overview: The lives of two French sisters are torn apart by the onset of World War II.

title: Emma Doucet
overview: Emma is bringing up her son Oscar alone. Her life is divided between her work, her voluntary work as a public writer, her lover and her son. Oscar gradually sinks into melancholy, his existential questions echoing those of his mother.

title: Second Chances
overview: A man frustrated by his life becomes friends with a dog as he goes back to school to try and reinvent himself.

title: The Comeback King
overview: A country western star named Aubrey must return to college to earn his long-abandoned degree after a false rumor that he cheated on his girlfriend throws his career into free fall.

title: The Station
overview: As Layal runs a women-only fuel station in a segregated war-torn town, she is faced with her 12-year-old brother’s growing desire to break free and become a ‘man’. When Layal’s estranged sister unexpectedly shows up with a proposition for their brother, the siblings’ relationship is put to the test.

title: Le Trésor
overview: Bankrupted after buying a guesthouse which has wrecked their relationship, Jean and Sarah think they’ve found a solution when they learn about a fabulous treasure which is said to be in the area. They set off determined to find it, even if it means falling in love again.

title: The Last Days of Napoléon
overview: It is a farewell story that focuses on the absolute loneliness Napoleon Bonaparte experienced during the final days of his life after being exiled to the island of Saint Helena, and his deep longing for his homeland.

title: Children of Liberty
overview: New York, 1941. When his father mysteriously vanishes at Grand Central, a boy and his new friend must navigate a city crawling with spies to find him and uncover a conspiracy that's bigger than either of them imagined.

title: Look At The Sky, Trust The Mountains
overview: A tense drama set after the Taliban takeover, following a French agent escorting an Afghan girl across a dangerous country as they form a life-changing bond.

title: Strawberries
overview: Hasna and Meriem leave their native Morocco to work a season picking strawberries in Spain, until abuse and harassment shatter their hopes. Supported by a Spanish lawyer, they must decide whether to speak out against a powerful system.

title: And Now It's Over
overview: Mauritius. A love story begins between Pierre, a local employee, and Louise, a French tourist suffering from anorexia. He shows her another side of his country: wild beaches, nightlife, bustling streets... Each, in their own way, dreams of escape and emancipation. But Louise's departure is approaching, and Pierre grows tense at the thought of staying on this island he is desperate to leave. He will risk everything in an attempt to escape a future that seems already written.

title: Visitation
overview: A plot of land, a house by the lake, its changing inhabitants. This one plot of land reflects 70 years of German history from Weimar, the Nazis, the war, the Soviet occupation and reconstruction to the fall of the GDR.

title: For the Moon
overview: Éric Baudelaire teams up with students at the National Institute for Blind Youth in Paris, arming them with their own cameras and empowering them to find beauty and visual texture in the world around them. Performing music, making art, or bearing witness to the tiniest details of their surrounding environment, their expressions are woven together to create a complete, subjective cinematic universe unto itself, whether capturing the tactility of everyday objects or moments of gorgeous abstraction.

title: Cry to Heaven
overview: Set in 18th-century Venice, the paths of two unlikely collaborators: a Venetian noble and a castrated singer from Calabria, both tries to succeed in the world of the opera.

title: #Karthi 30
overview: A superhero fantasy entertainer

title: Résilience
overview: Joseph is an isolated elderly Deaf man who lives alone and likes it that way. When his nephew gifts him a computer, he reluctantly learns to use the internet, which opens an unexpected door into his past.

title: Barbie and Ken
overview: When an unexpected glitch in the digital world threatens to delete their entire neighborhood, Barbie and Ken must team up with an eclectic crew of local characters to find the "Master Code" before their world goes permanently offline.

title: Brave Cat
overview: Teenage forest cat Kona decides to face her fears and search for her missing mother, who was kidnapped by the circus long ago. She is joined on her journey by Colin, an abandoned guard dog pup, and Bernard, a runaway old circus bear, who are also searching for their own families.

title: The Surgeon
overview: A former surgeon is kidnapped and given an impossible choice.

title: Sai: Disaster
overview: Four people lead ordinary lives in different places, their paths never crossing. A mysterious man appears in each story, always as someone else. One moment, a cram school instructor; the next, a truck driver, a barber; his identity constantly shifting. Then, death strikes. A detective pursues the truth, closing in on a revelation.

title: Prosecution
overview: After surviving a racist attack, state prosecutor Seyo Kim takes her own case to court – confronting both the perpetrators and a justice system that turns a blind eye to right-wing extremism.

title: H24
overview: To avoid going to prison, Mélanie—an impulsive, outspoken young woman—is forced to train as a nursing assistant. The problem is, she faints at the slightest needle prick or drop of blood. After yet another blunder, she has no choice but to accept a job that’s completely unsuitable for her: providing round-the-clock care for a 65-year-old obsessive businessman who has just survived a stroke and can’t stand anyone invading his personal space. With these two together, their living arrangement promises to be explosive…

title: Not Alone
overview: While preparing for a revolutionary space launch, an introverted rocket mechanic and a brilliant astro-botanist spark an unexpected romance—only for three runaway aliens to crash-land in his home, looking for a ride back to the stars.
